rule: Dominican players almost always play double six and keep score to one hundred.
quote: llevar las cuentas hasta un ciento

rule: With four players, only the losers' tiles are counted.
quote: En esa modalidad solo se cuentan las fichas de los perdedores.

rule: Some players play to more than 100 and give different values to various plays (bonuses).
quote: complican el juego al llevar más allá de cien la cuenta final

rule: In Dominican dominoes, points are called 'tantos'.
quote: Los puntos se llaman “tantos”.

rule: Regla general: the winning pair scores the losing pair's remaining tiles. Patio (informal) games count all remaining tiles, including the winner's partner.
quote: En los juegos de patio (informal) se suman los puntos de todas las fichas restantes.

rule: A Dominican game is several hands and ends when a pair reaches or passes 100 or 200 points.
quote: termina cuando una de las parejas alcanza o supera 100 o 200 puntos

rule: Dominican games are played to 200, 250, or 500 points.
quote: Games are played to a total of 200, 250, or 500 points

rule: When a player goes out, the points in the opponents' hands go to his team. In games to 500, the points of all players' tiles are counted.
quote: In games of 500 points all the pieces of the players are added

rule: Santiago tournament (2019): games are played to 200 tantos, and all tiles are counted.
quote: SE JUGARA A LOS 200 TANTOS Y SE CUENTA TODAS LAS FICHAS.
sourceName: Momento Deportivo RD, Copa Alcaldía de Santiago rules (2019)

rule: Regla general (Latin style): the winning pair adds the points of the tiles left in the losing pair's hands.
quote: suma los puntos de las fichas restantes en las manos de la pareja perdedora

rule: The game ends when a pair reaches or passes 100 or 200 points, depending on the agreed rules.
quote: La partida termina cuando una pareja alcanza o supera 100 o 200 puntos

rule: Forum answer from a DR resident: when a player goes out, all unplayed tiles are added, and the first pair to 200 wins.
quote: the first pair to 200 points wins the game.

rule: Games in the DR are usually played to 200, 250, or 500 points.
quote: dominoes games here are usually played to 200, 250 or 500 points
sourceName: Zen Cabarete (formerly eXtreme Hotels) blog, Dominoes in the Dominican

rule: FichaFlow: the classic Dominican target is 200. Shorter games use 100 or 150; the target is a table agreement.
quote: The classic Dominican target is 200 points, but 100 and 150 are common

rule: Generic variant: after a locked game, both pairs record their own points. With this method both pairs can pass 200 in the same hand, which forces a tiebreak hand. The standard rule lets only the winner score.
quote: existe la posibilidad de que ambas parejas superen los 200 puntos en una misma partida
sourceName: Kapiku (domino table maker), Reglas del dominó

rule: Generic variant: if each team scores its own unplayed tiles in a blocked game, both can reach the target together. The lower total then wins, and a tie means another deal.
quote: both teams can reach 100 or more points as a result of a blocked game

rule: USA Domino Federation tournaments: games go to 200 tantos or 35 minutes, whichever comes first.
quote: Los JUEGOS serán de 200 tantos o 35 minutos, lo que ocurra primero.

rule: Generic Spanish custom: in unofficial games, scores are often rounded to tens (for example, 32 is scored as 4 and 7 as 1).
quote: Es común en partidas no oficiales redondear a la decena

rule: FID: when a pair goes out (dominada), it scores all unplayed tiles in the hand, including its own partner's.
quote: se contabilizarán todas las fichas no jugadas en la mano
sourceName: Federación Internacional de Dominó, Reglamento de Juego (2015, Art. 57)

rule: FID: the match is won by the pair that first reaches the target by capturing points in hands. The rules have no bonuses, so only hand points count.
quote: la pareja que captura puntos hasta alcanzar primero que la otra
sourceName: Federación Internacional de Dominó, Reglamento de Juego (2015, Art. 62)

rule: FID world championships: matches go to 200 points or a time limit (40 minutes in 2015, 35 minutes in 2024), with 300 points in exceptional cases.
quote: quince (15) partidos a doscientos (200) puntos
sourceName: Federación Internacional de Dominó, Reglamento de Juego (2015, Art. 61)

rule: FEMUNDO world championship (attended by Fededodo): matches go to 200 tantos or 40 minutes, whichever comes first.
quote: Las partidas tendrán una duración de 40 minutos o 200 tantos

rule: FEMUNDO: when a player goes out, the points of the 3 players still holding tiles are scored. This includes the winner's partner.
quote: En cada dominación, se anotan los puntos de los 3 atletas

rule: Dominican regla general: the winning pair counts only the losing pair's unplayed tiles. In patio (informal) games, all remaining tiles are counted.
quote: En los juegos de patio (informal) se suman los puntos de todas las fichas restantes

rule: Dominican game: the match ends when a pair reaches or exceeds 100 or 200 points.
quote: termina cuando una de las parejas alcanza o supera 100 o 200 puntos

rule: Dominican games go to 200, 250 or 500. In games to 200 or 250, going out scores the opponents' tiles.
quote: Games are played to a total of 200, 250, or 500 points

rule: In games to 500, all players' tiles are added to the winner's score, including the partner's.
quote: In games of 500 points all the pieces of the players are added

rule: Santiago 2019 tournament: the game goes to 200 tantos and all tiles are counted.
quote: SE JUGARA A LOS 200 TANTOS Y SE CUENTA TODAS LAS FICHAS
sourceName: Momento Deportivo RD, Copa Alcaldía de Santiago rules (2019)

rule: Dominicans almost always play double six and keep score to 100 ('un ciento'). Some players go past 100 and give some plays different values.
quote: llevar las cuentas hasta un ciento

rule: In the four-player Dominican game, only the losers' tiles are counted.
quote: En esa modalidad solo se cuentan las fichas de los perdedores.

rule: 'Dominó latino' (generic): count only the losing pair's unplayed points. The partner of the player who went out is not counted.
quote: Se cuentan los puntos no jugados de la pareja perdedora
sourceName: Dominó, arte o ciencia: Reglas del Dominó

rule: Dominican dominoes are scored to 200, 250 or 500, as the players prefer.
quote: Score the game to 200, 250 or 500 depending on preference.
sourceName: Our Pastimes, 'How to Play Dominican Dominoes'

rule: App: the classic Dominican target is 200, and 100 and 150 are common for shorter games. The target is a table agreement.

rule: App: the winning partnership scores the pips in every other player's hand, which includes the partner's. The first to 100 wins.

rule: USA Domino Federation: games go to 200 tantos or 35 minutes, whichever comes first.

rule: When a player goes out, the pips left in the opponents' hands are added to the winner's team (games to 200 or 250).

rule: In games to 500, all players' remaining tiles (including the partner's) are added to the winning team.

rule: Dominican games are played to 200, 250 or 500 points.

rule: The match ends when a pair reaches or passes 100 or 200 points.

rule: La Mesa: the winning pair scores the pips left in all four hands (or only the blocked team's points, by table custom).

rule: La Mesa: the game is usually to 200 (some tables 100 or 150), and the first pair to cross the total wins.
